patterns.statement: Shared bars should refresh on a timer and only write changed values, not on every single hit.
patterns.condition: When one shared display (boss bar, team score, shared progress) would be redrawn on every hit or event, for every player at once.
patterns.action: Refresh the shared display on a fixed timer with a low rate, and write only the values that actually changed.

patterns.statement: Keep saved data in its own module with one write path, separate from game logic, so one mistake cannot wipe unrelated progress.
patterns.condition: When one saved-data store is shared by several unrelated systems (progress, unlocks, stats, purchases) and is written from one large script.
patterns.action: Move the storage into its own module with a single write path, separate from gameplay logic, and run a save-and-reload check after every change to it.

patterns.statement: When many awards land at the same moment, queue them and let each consumer drain the queue, so no reward is silently lost.
patterns.condition: When many awards land at the same instant and each consumer listens again only after handling the previous signal.
patterns.action: Queue each recipient's amount in one shared place and let every consumer drain that queue, instead of firing one signal per recipient in a tight loop.
